name: Zotero
tagline: Free, open-source reference manager that saves, organizes and cites research; optional paid cloud storage and sync

evidence.quote: operated by the Corporation for Digital Scholarship

vendor_entity.note: Terms of Service name CDS as operator (offices in Falls Church, VA). Footer calls Zotero a project of Digital Scholar.

evidence.quote: operated by the Corporation for Digital Scholarship

vendor_country.note: Terms: operated 'from its offices within the United States on a not-for-profit basis'.

parent_company.note: Looked at terms, privacy policy and site footer. No parent or owner named. Footer says 'a project of Digital Scholar'; terms name the Corporation for Digital Scholarship.

eu_representative.note: Vendor is US-based. Privacy policy (last updated 2026-11-05) names no GDPR Art. 27 representative.

evidence.quote: please ask us in the Zotero Forums or email privacy@zotero.org
All data is currently stored in the us-east-1 AWS region in the United States.
If institutional policies prevent uploading of data to third-party servers, Zotero can always be used locally without syncing any data

local_first.note: Group libraries need sync, which stores data in the US (AWS us-east-1).

evidence.quote: All Zotero server data is stored in the United States in Amazon Web Services.

eu_residency.note: Sync server data stays in the US; no EU hosting option found. The desktop app keeps data locally unless sync is enabled.

evidence.quote: All Zotero server data is stored in the United States in Amazon Web Services.

transfer_mechanism.note: Privacy policy and terms do not name the EU-US DPF, SCCs or BCRs. A web search for the DPF listing returned nothing for the Corporation for Digital Scholarship; dataprivacyframework.gov was not checked directly.

subprocessors_public.note: /subprocessors returned 404. The privacy policy has a 'Third-Party Services Used' section that names providers (AWS, Stripe, Intuit, Anrok, VAT IT, Crossref, Library of Congress, reCAPTCHA/hCaptcha/Turnstile, myfonts.com, Inworld AI or Google for Premium voices) without calling them sub-processors.

subprocessors_count.note: No sub-processor list published; see subprocessors_public note.

subprocessors_non_eea.note: No sub-processor list published. Privacy policy says Zotero server data is stored in the US.

subprocessor_notice.note: No sub-processor change notice process found. Terms say CDS will notify users of material changes to the Services.

dpa.note: /dpa resolves to a Zotero group page, not a DPA. Terms of Service and privacy policy contain no DPA clause. Web search found no Zotero DPA.

evidence.quote: you automatically grant to CDS and its service providers a royalty-free license and right to store, display, process, modify, and retransmit your Submissions
Zotero anonymizes and aggregates synchronized user and group library data to generate statistics on readership

role.note: Processes synced content to run the service and uses anonymized, aggregated library data for its own statistics. The pages do not use the words processor or controller.

evidence.quote: Last updated 2026-11-05
Backups may be retained for up to 6 months.

retention_stated.note: Stated for backups of library data. Free accounts inactive for 90 days may have files deleted (terms section 3).

evidence.quote: To delete your account, visit your Zotero settings and click
Backups may be retained for up to 6 months.

deletion_on_exit.note: Self-service account deletion. Time frame given only for backups.

evidence.quote: import and export items in various file formats (e.g. BibTeX, RIS, etc.)
Zotero has always guaranteed users complete access to their own data

data_export.note: Item export to BibTeX/RIS and similar formats is documented. Full-library export and attachment export are not described on the pages checked.

breach_notice.note: No breach-notification window found in privacy policy, terms or security page.

evidence.quote: will be governed by the laws of Virginia

governing_law.note: Virginia law; exclusive venue in Virginia courts.

ai_features.note: No generative AI feature found on the product, docs or privacy pages. Read Aloud (text-to-speech) is documented but is not generative AI. Not confirmed as absent by the vendor.

evidence.quote: When using Premium voices with Read Aloud, document text is sent to external providers for text-to-speech processing.
Currently, these providers may include Inworld AI or Google.

ai_providers.note: Applies only to Read Aloud Premium voices (text-to-speech). Standard voices run on Zotero servers. 'other' = Inworld AI.

trains_on_content.note: No training clause found. Privacy policy says no information beyond the document text is sent to the third-party TTS providers. Library statistics are described as anonymized and aggregated.

ai_zero_retention.note: Not stated for the Premium voice providers.

ai_admin_off.note: No institution admin setting for Read Aloud or AI found.

ai_act_statement.note: No EU AI Act statement found.

evidence.quote: These are enterprise certifications that aren't realistic for an organization of our size.

certifications.note: No ISO, SOC or similar certificate found on the security page. Zotero Team forum post (March 2025) says enterprise certifications are not realistic for its size.

evidence.quote: If you believe you’ve found a security issue in Zotero software, please contact security@zotero.org
all data is encrypted in transit with current best practices
Data in newly created accounts is also encrypted at rest using AES-256.

encryption.note: At-rest encryption is stated only for newly created accounts. No customer-managed keys or end-to-end encryption for sync.

pentest.note: No penetration test summary found on the security page.

evidence.quote: If you believe you’ve found a security issue in Zotero software, please contact security@zotero.org

vuln_disclosure.note: Disclosure contact only. No bug bounty and no security.txt (/.well-known/security.txt returned 404).

incidents.note: No Zotero-announced breach or regulator fine found in searches. A 2025 state agency security-risk designation was disputed by Zotero (forum thread 122156). A 2025 Bugcrowd report concerned an API key exposed in a third party's public repository, not a Zotero breach.

status_page.note: No status page link on the homepage or getting-help page. status.zotero.org does not resolve.

evidence.quote: There's no current support for any SSO solution.

sso.note: Forum reply dated 2024-07-22; the replier's role is not shown on the cached page. Institution storage plans use email domain matching, not SSO.

federation.note: Searched for eduGAIN, SWAMID, Haka, Feide, WAYF, InCommon, UK Federation and AAF listings. None found.

evidence.quote: This allows you to use a password manager to auto-fill credentials and will enable two-factor authentication

mfa.note: Blog post on web-based login says two-factor authentication is 'currently in beta'. Not confirmed as generally available.

evidence.quote: A simple administrative interface lets you add or remove users from your Zotero Lab subscription at any time.

admin_console.note: Admin interface is for Lab plans (user management). Usage reports not stated.

lms_integration.note: No LMS integration (LTI, Canvas, Moodle, etc.) found on the pages checked.

evidence.quote: You can download our latest VPAT/ACR here

vpat.note: VPAT 2.5 for the desktop app dated October 24, 2024. VPATs for the web library and ZoteroBib are planned for 2026.

evidence.quote: As of October 2024, the Zotero desktop app fully meets the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 Level AA.

wcag_level.note: Claim covers the desktop app only.

evidence.quote: At Zotero, we’re committed to building software that is accessible to everyone, including people with disabilities.

accessibility_statement.note: Published accessibility page. Not checked against EAA statement content requirements.

evidence.quote: We can provide a HECVAT (an assessment tool used by higher-education institutions to evaluate security and privacy) on request.

hecvat.note: Forum post by the Zotero Team, March 2025. Not on a public page. No published HECVAT found.

ferpa.note: No FERPA statement or school-official terms found in terms or privacy policy.

section_508.note: Section 508 not mentioned on the accessibility page. The VPAT was not opened.

state_privacy.note: No SDPC, CCPA or NY Ed Law 2-d terms found.

uk_gdpr.note: No IDTA or UK addendum found.

au_privacy.note: No Australian Privacy Principles statement, IRAP assessment or AU hosting found.

free_plan.note: Desktop app is free. Free sync storage is 300 MB.

price_individual.note: Paid tiers are storage plans: 6 GB $60/year, unlimited $120/year.

evidence.quote: Zotero Institution provides unlimited storage for entire universities, research institutions, and corporations.

institutional_licence.note: Zotero Lab (from $450/year for up to 15 users) and Zotero Institution (US$2,380/year for the first 500 FTE).

edu_discount.note: No student or academic discount stated on the storage pages checked.

evidence.quote: Unlimited $120/year (equal to $10 per month)

With support for over 9,000 citation styles, you can format your work to match any style guide or publication.
keeping your files, notes, and bibliographic records seamlessly up to date

capabilities.note: Based on product pages. Read Aloud text-to-speech exists but is not a listed option.

languages.note: No count or list of interface languages found. /support/languages returned 404.

primarily the AGPLv3
